notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Central US Lookouts page gives the NGS survey description and an undated 'Removed' status; it gives no build or removal date, so none is used. Wikipedia is cited for location only. An encyclopedia mirror (grokipedia.com) says the tower was removed by 2016 but cites only the Central US Lookouts page, so that date is not used. A Facebook group post says the tower went up in the 1950s; unverified and not used. The brief's 27.4 m matches 'about 90 feet'. The 1987 USGS Success quad date in the NGS text is not treated as a tower date. Access and staffing left out. anyplaceamerica.com and news-leader.com returned 403.
